query: What minimal sample size—number of preparations and labeled segments per class—and SNR/cycle-count thresholds are required to detect low-dimensional chaos reliably in short noisy biological time series?

response.query: What minimal sample size—number of preparations and labeled segments per class—and SNR/cycle-count thresholds are required to detect low-dimensional chaos reliably in short noisy biological time series?
response.answer: To reliably detect low-dimensional chaos in short noisy biological time series, a sample size of at least 100 labeled segments per class and SNR/cycle-count thresholds above 5 is typically required.
